conflicts.permit: We may use personal information submitted by you only for the following purposes: help us to develop, deliver, and improve our products and services and supply higher quality service.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not collect Personal Information, and we employ administrative, physical and electronic measures designed to protect your Non-Personal Information from unauthorized access and use.
conflicts.situation: A user submits personal information to Horizone Media while using the services.
conflicts.reason: The policy flatly asserts 'We do not collect Personal Information' under Security without accommodating or referencing the personal information users submit.
